notes.title: Thank you!!!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

We are closing in on 2 months since To Light: Ex Umbra released! I just wanted to take a moment to say thank you SO much for your support and for all the feedback!

If you haven't already, be sure to leave a review! It really does help out :D

Also, if you ever have any issues with bugs or anything else, don't hesitate to let me know, and I will get it taken care of as quickly as I can.

-Craig

notes.title: Version 1.0.4
notes.content:
Fixes:
-puzzle direction issues
-leftover sprites after cutscene
-removed leftover testing functions (endless gold glitch)
-fixed issue that allowed player to access post-game side quest early, resulting in game freezing in final sequence
-misc.
